description: 当前 PRD 只跟踪新的剩余 Java 行覆盖率收口计划。旧的已完成 story 和已被新计划覆盖的旧未完成 story 已全部移除。覆盖率事实来源以当前模块级 JaCoCo 报告和 docs/prds/java-unit-line-coverage-remaining-v2-prd.md 为准。

userStories.title: 收敛剩余覆盖率计划与口径
userStories.description: 作为维护者，我希望把当前真实剩余的 JaCoCo 缺口重新整理成新的执行计划，并明确核心类与非核心类的不同验收口径，以便后续补测顺序和标准一致。
acceptanceCriteria: Use the current module-level JaCoCo reports as the source of truth for remaining uncovered Java classes
Check in a plan document that sorts remaining work primarily by implementation difficulty and secondarily by missed-line size within each difficulty band
Define that core production classes must reach 100% line coverage with full functional tests rather than coverage-only tests
Define that non-core supporting classes may use a two-stage approach: normal tests to roughly 90%, then coverage-only tail cleanup from 90% to 100%
Link the remaining-class line detail inventory from the plan so each class can be worked directly from concrete line numbers
userStories.notes: Source-of-truth docs for this story: docs/prds/java-unit-line-coverage-remaining-v2-prd.md and docs/prds/java-unit-line-coverage-remaining-v2-line-detail.md. Current baseline from 2026-05-05 module-level JaCoCo: 96 classes and 548 missed lines remain.

userStories.title: 先清简单非核心覆盖率缺口到 100%
userStories.description: 作为维护者，我希望先把 DTO、properties、exception、main、repository 接口声明和简单 smoke 入口类清完，以便快速减少剩余类数并缩小门禁范围。
acceptanceCriteria: Target the easy non-core classes listed in the remaining coverage plan first, including DTOs, properties, exceptions, simple inner classes, main entrypoints, and lightweight repository or config smoke targets
Each targeted non-core class in this story reaches 100% line coverage before the story is considered done
Tests keep at least minimal executable assertions, but do not need exhaustive business-path depth for these simple support classes
Update the tracked inventory and coverage notes to remove the completed classes from the remaining list
userStories.notes: Primary targets live in Wave 1 and Wave 2 of docs/prds/java-unit-line-coverage-remaining-v2-prd.md.

userStories.title: 清中等难度非核心 app 与 infra 覆盖率缺口到 100%
userStories.description: 作为维护者，我希望在简单类之后清掉 controller 尾差、filter、rate-limit、scanner seam、轻量 repository helper 和中等 app service，以便把真正困难的类单独留到最后。
acceptanceCriteria: Target the medium-difficulty non-core classes listed in the remaining coverage plan, especially supporting controllers, filters, rate-limiters, scanner adapters, bootstrap helpers, and small app services
Each targeted non-core class in this story reaches 100% line coverage before the story is considered done
Tests should still follow normal testing style with basic assertions and should not default to coverage-only tail tests yet
Update the tracked inventory and coverage notes to remove the completed classes from the remaining list
userStories.notes: Primary targets live in Wave 2 and Wave 3 of docs/prds/java-unit-line-coverage-remaining-v2-prd.md.

userStories.title: 核心功能类直接用完整功能测试做到 100%
userStories.description: 作为维护者，我希望把剩余核心功能类直接补到 100% 行覆盖率，并保持完整功能断言，以确保主链路的覆盖质量不被尾差策略稀释。
acceptanceCriteria: Target all remaining core classes listed in the remaining coverage plan and classify them as requiring full functional tests
Each targeted core production class reaches 100% line coverage before the story is considered done
Tests cover the real functional paths, state transitions, and core failure semantics that matter for the class, rather than only touching lines
Coverage-only or no-assertion tests are not used as the primary means to satisfy this story
Update the tracked inventory and coverage notes to remove the completed core classes from the remaining list
userStories.notes: Current core list includes LocalAuthService, PasswordResetService, DeviceAuthService, SecurityConfig, AuthController, UserProfileController, SkillDeleteAppService, S3StorageService, SkillPackagePolicy, SkillPackageValidator, BasicPrePublishValidator, SkillMetadataParser, NamespaceService, ProfileReviewService, LabelPermissionChecker, and SkillRating.

userStories.title: 困难非核心类先收敛到约 90%
userStories.description: 作为维护者，我希望把剩余困难但非核心的支撑类先拉到大约 90% 行覆盖率，以便把真正阻塞 100% 的尾差行集中留到单独一轮处理。
acceptanceCriteria: Target the remaining difficult non-core classes from the current coverage plan, such as AdminUserSearchRepository, JpaGovernanceQueryRepository, GitHubClaimsExtractor, MockAuthFilter, GitLabClaimsExtractor, and SkillHubOAuth2AuthorizationRequestResolver
Each targeted non-core class in this story reaches roughly 90% line coverage or better through normal tests with basic assertions
The remaining uncovered lines after this story are limited mainly to special tail branches, helper lines, cleanup lines, or low-value edge paths
Update the tracked inventory and coverage notes with the reduced missed-line counts for these classes
userStories.notes: This is explicitly a staging story for difficult non-core classes only; it does not apply to core classes.

userStories.title: 困难非核心类从 90% 清尾到 100%
userStories.description: 作为维护者，我希望把困难非核心类最后剩下的少量尾差行集中清掉，以便在不稀释核心测试质量的前提下完成全仓 100% line coverage。
acceptanceCriteria: Only after the targeted non-core classes have first reached roughly 90% through normal tests, add focused tail-cleanup tests to take them to 100%
Coverage-only tests in this story are limited to the remaining special tail lines and do not replace functional tests for the main behavior
Each targeted non-core class completed in this story reaches 100% line coverage before the story is considered done
Update the tracked inventory and coverage notes to remove the completed classes from the remaining list
userStories.notes: Allowed tactics in this story include reflection, helper smoke tests, low-assertion tail-line tests, and direct invocation of cleanup or anonymous-inner-class paths, but only for non-core residual lines.

userStories.title: 执行全量后端单测并验证 Java 行覆盖率 100%
userStories.description: 作为维护者，我希望在所有补测完成后运行一次全量后端单测和覆盖率报告，以便确认不是局部模块看起来达标，而是当前仓库整体 Java 生产代码都已经达到 100% line coverage。
acceptanceCriteria: Run the agreed full backend unit-test command set after all remaining coverage stories are completed
Regenerate the module-level JaCoCo reports and confirm that no Java production class still has LINE_MISSED greater than 0
Confirm that the final tracked inventory of remaining uncovered classes is empty
Update the tracked coverage notes or baseline file to record the final 100% line coverage result
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: This is the final unit-test gate for the remaining coverage program. It should fail if any module-level jacoco.csv still contains uncovered production lines.

userStories.title: 执行端到端回归验证以防补测过程引入行为回归
userStories.description: 作为交付负责人，我希望在全量单测与 100% 覆盖率达标之后，再做一次端到端回归验证，以便确认补单测过程中没有通过修改生产代码破坏真实业务行为。
acceptanceCriteria: After US-108F passes, run the agreed end-to-end regression validation on the current main path
Verify at least the login flow, one publish-related flow, one search flow, and one governance or review flow
Confirm the backend health endpoint is UP during the validation run
Record the regression-validation result in tracked project notes or docs together with the final coverage result
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: The purpose of this story is to catch production-code regressions that might have been introduced while chasing coverage. This validation happens only after final 100% unit coverage has been confirmed.
